style: Editorial 16:9 illustration, dark navy background, restrained teal and amber accents, generous negative space. Use conceptual shapes, not a literal execution trace.

layouts.flow: Two abstract blocks connected by a curved path.
layouts.barrier: Two abstract blocks separated by a visible gap.
layouts.cycle: A segmented circular path surrounding an abstract block.

symbols.arrows: One simple directional arrow guides the eye.
symbols.gate: One abstract gate marks a boundary.
symbols.loop: One curved return path provides the focal point.
symbols.shield: One abstract shield acts as an editorial motif, not a security guarantee.

text_policy: No visible text, lettering, labels, numbers, logos, code or screenshots. Do not depict a guaranteed fix.
